questions.question: What is transferred from one organism to another?
questions.fact: That energy is transferred from one organism to another.
questions.explanation: The fact states that energy is transferred from one organism to another.

questions.question: What do the Greek roots of the word autotroph mean?
questions.fact: The Greek roots of the word autotroph mean "self" (auto) "feeder" (troph).

questions.question: Where is the chemical energy that runs each cell mainly found?
questions.fact: Each cell runs on the chemical energy found mainly in carbohydrate molecules (food).
questions.explanation: Chemical energy is found mainly in carbohydrate molecules (food).

questions.question: What are deer?
questions.explanation: The fact states that deer are heterotrophs.

questions.question: What do certain organisms convert solar energy (sunlight) into through photosynthesis?
questions.fact: Through photosynthesis certain organisms convert solar energy (sunlight) into chemical energy.
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis converts solar energy (sunlight) into chemical energy.

questions.question: What do cells use released energy for?
options: To perform work such as cellular respiration
questions.answer: To perform work such as cellular respiration
questions.fact: Cells use the released energy to perform work such as cellular respiration.
questions.explanation: Cells use released energy to perform work such as cellular respiration.

questions.question: Which statement about photosynthesis is true?
options: Some organisms can carry out photosynthesis, whereas others cannot
Every organism must carry out photosynthesis
All organisms can carry out photosynthesis
No organisms can carry out photosynthesis
questions.answer: Some organisms can carry out photosynthesis, whereas others cannot
questions.fact: Some organisms can carry out photosynthesis, whereas others cannot.
questions.explanation: Some organisms can carry out photosynthesis, whereas others cannot.

questions.question: What is the chemical energy from photosynthesis used to build?
questions.fact: The chemical energy from photosynthesis is used to build carbohydrate molecules.
questions.explanation: Chemical energy from photosynthesis is used to build carbohydrate molecules.

questions.question: What provides most of the energy needed by living things on Earth?
questions.fact: Photosynthesis provides most of the energy required by living things on earth, directly or indirectly.
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis provides most of the energy required by living things on earth.

questions.question: Which organisms are the best-known autotrophs?
What continuously enters Earth’s ecosystems?
questions.fact: Energy harnessed from photosynthesis continuously enters Earth’s ecosystems.
questions.explanation: Energy harnessed from photosynthesis continuously enters Earth’s ecosystems.

questions.question: What do oceanic algae contribute in enormous quantities to global food chains?
questions.fact: Oceanic algae contribute enormous quantities of oxygen to global food chains.
questions.explanation: Oceanic algae contribute enormous quantities of oxygen to global food chains.

questions.question: What do all living organisms on earth consist of?
questions.fact: All living organisms on earth consist of one or more cells.
questions.explanation: All living organisms on earth consist of one or more cells.
